rule_or_pattern: Same vouli-wide breathing rule as dossiers 008/012: drop lines containing a word that begins with a bare capital vowel without breathing (on it or on the next diphthong vowel): (?:^|[\s(\[«])[ΑΕΗΙΟΥΩ](?![\u1F00-\u1FFF])(?:[\u03B1-\u03C9\u03AC-\u03CE]|\s|$).
notes: This is a single-column 1843 session record whose body text reads correctly (1, 4-8, 10-12, 21-23, 26-31, 34-39). The breathing on a capital is systematically lost: 'Αθανάσιος' (2), 'Αναστάσιος' (24), 'Ο Κ.' (25), 'Ακολούθως' (32), 'Αναγνωρισθέντων' (40). Breathed capitals are also lowercased in 9 ('ἀντιπρόεδροι' for printed 'Ἀντιπρόεδροι'), 13 ('ὄθωνα' for 'Ὄθωνα') and 33 ('ὁ Κ.' for 'Ὁ Κ.'). The regex cannot catch that residual case error.
